title: acetosella heterophylla
intro: Acetosella heterophylla, commonly known as the red trefoil or strawberry clover, is a perennial plant species in the pea family (Fabaceae). This plant has been traditionally used to support digestive health, and its health benefits include relief from diarrhea, nausea, and other gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Acetosella heterophylla are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which help to soothe and calm the digestive system. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are known for their antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
